title: Pullback of a sheaf of modules along a morphism of schemes
statement:
Let $g:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, with underlying continuous map $g$ and ring-sheaf map $g^\sharp:\mathcal O_Y\to g_*\mathcal O_X$, equivalently $g^{-1}\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X$. For a sheaf of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules $\mathcal G$ (on the Zariski site of $Y$), the *pullback* $g^*\mathcal G$ is the sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules

$$
g^*\mathcal G=\mathcal O_X\otimes_{g^{-1}\mathcal O_Y}g^{-1}\mathcal G,
$$

where $g^{-1}\mathcal G$ is the inverse image sheaf of abelian groups (sheafification of $V\mapsto\varinjlim_{U\supseteq g(V)}\mathcal G(U)$) with its $g^{-1}\mathcal O_Y$-module structure. This is a functor $g^*:\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)\to\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$, left adjoint to the pushforward $g_*:\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)\to\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)$, with $\mathrm{id}^*\cong\mathrm{id}$ and $(h\circ g)^*\cong g^*h^*$.
